name: Bonefish Bay Resort
note: Small RV park sharing its grounds with a motel, cabins and floating lodges. RV sites are booked and priced by phone; the online engine sells only the cabins and lodges. --Claude
inclusion_evidence: Operator site bonefishbayresort.com read 2026-10-30: '17 RV Sites with full Hookups', RV restroom and coin laundry, 'Call for Motel Room & RV Site Rates and Reservations (305) 289-0565' (its Sirvoy engine sells only cabins and aqua lodges); Esri satellite (rendered 2026-10-30) shows RVs parked on the west gravel row; RV Life reviews of paid nightly motorhome stays (Dynamax Isata Mar 2023 $135, Newmar Ventana Nov 2022 $100, others Dec 2021); a Google review from about a year ago says 'There are RV sites'; Google Maps open, 4.3/333, phone matches; RV Life $$$$ counts as the price indicator in the Keys (AWH 2026-10-30) -> real transient RV park; price gate lifted: Florida Keys zone (AWH 2026-10-30, gateways.py)
waterfront_evidence: 2026-10-30: the operator's site map (bonefish_sitemap5b.jpg on bonefishbayresort.com) puts RV sites F-M in a row along the west line, site F at the head of a cove; that only triggered the audit. Esri satellite (sat.py, rendered: 800 m frame at 24.7305,-81.0214, 220 m at 24.7303,-81.0213, 100 m at 24.7306,-81.0218, 80 m at the pin): the west RV row backs onto a ~70 m mangrove forest with no water in reach, and the 'cove' is a dredged boat slip ~9 m wide, now holding the floating aqua lodges, that runs ~45 m south to the open sound. The slip's head lies ~7 m from the southernmost site's picnic table across open gravel with no buffer, so that pad is on narrow canal water: creekside under the canal rule, not bayfront, because the pads face the slip, not the open bay. The south-end sites A-D, which faced the bay, are now cabins on the imagery. Label settled 2026-10-30 (Claude, reviewing): defaulted down to not waterfront. The only water-adjacent pad is one site beside a 9 m dredged slip now occupied by floating lodges, and the imagery can't confirm it is still an RV pad; the rest of the RV row backs onto mangrove.
flags: No dated rate: the operator posts no RV price ('call for rates') and has no RV booking engine. Passes on RV Life $$$$ per the AWH 2026-10-30 Keys ruling. RV Life reviewers paid $100-135 a night in 2020-2023 (camper-reported, not used as fees).

RV inventory has shrunk: the site still says 17 RV sites, RV Life says 13, and the imagery shows the old south-end sites A-D (the '5 on the water' a 2021 reviewer described) replaced by cabins. About 8 RV pads remain in the west row (5 RVs parked on the imagery), plus possibly sites N-R.

No standing minimum found: RV Life reviews describe nightly, 11-night and weekly stays. The 7-night minimum on the operator site applies only to the stilt house. No weekly/monthly program or seasonal residents are documented, but the RVs on the imagery could be long-stayers (no count anywhere).
Fit: a ~30-ft Dynamax Isata and a Newmar Ventana Class A stayed (RV Life 2022-23); RV Life tip: big rigs should approach from the west (turn at Sombrero Beach Rd) because of the driveway angle.
Google 4.3/333; the newest reviews are mostly motel and cabin stays, and one negative review from about 4 months ago criticizes the RV water hookup.
